name: Render's Rock
summary: Blackrock orcs hold Render's Rock above Redridge, near the pass to the Burning Steppes. From this cave, they prepare attacks on the valleys below.

sections.title: A Blackrock Bastion in the Heights
sections.body: North of Lakeshire, Blackrock orcs guard a cave cut into the Redridge heights. The stronghold lies near the mountain pass leading to the Burning Steppes, where veteran orcs direct attacks against Redridge's defenders. Their guards make any attempt to enter perilous, whether to disrupt the orcs' supply lines or recover captives lost in the fighting.

sections.title: A Hostage in the Shadows
sections.body: Corporal Keeshan, a wounded Redridge soldier, is held inside Render's Rock. Isolated deep behind enemy lines, he is far from his companions. His captivity shows how boldly the Blackrock orcs press their attacks, and what the local garrison has paid to keep the mountain road open.

faq.answer: Render's Rock lies in the northwestern peaks of the Redridge Mountains, near the path north into the Burning Steppes.
Blackrock orcs control Render's Rock and use the crag as a redoubt to coordinate attacks and watch the mountain passes by the Burning Steppes.

faq.q: Who is imprisoned inside the cave?
aliases: who is trapped in renders rock
faq.answer: Corporal Keeshan, a wounded veteran of the Alliance garrison, is held captive inside Render's Rock and needs help escaping to Lakeshire.

faq.q: Why is this cave important to Lakeshire's defense?
faq.answer: Experienced Blackrock warriors hold Render's Rock above the Redridge valley, threatening Lakeshire and giving the orcs a foothold south of the Burning Steppes.

angles.text: As an Alliance fighter, you face one of Redridge's most entrenched Blackrock positions at Render's Rock. Clearing it can free Corporal Keeshan and protect Lakeshire.
